items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: We had Ken Ricks (?). We broadcast with Ken Ricks from maybe 12 o'clock at night until 4 in the morning.

ctx.x: On The Congo Roof Garden. No, Congo Roof Garden. What else? We sat up there with no hats on and burned the hell out of us, sweating like hell ... but we had -- thank you, Ken Stan, that's wonderful of you. We had Ken Ricks (?). We broadcast with Ken Ricks from maybe 12 o'clock at night until 4 in the morning. And I had some other gigs with a guy that liked my little trumpet playing and I had a little gig in the afternoon for WIL.
So now we're up to radio time now.
